title: 日本ダービーの後に・開かれた窓

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Embracing her own style of racing, Mejiro Bright manages to hold her own during the formidable Japanese Derby and emerges victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka observes this and vows to rid herself of doubt so that she may capture the scenery she couldn't see today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright, without hesitation, decides on the Kikuka Sho as her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To the Mejiro family, who places great emphasis on winning prestigious events like the Tenno Sho and the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho is another race she cannot ignore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her desires are aligned firmly with what the family wants.
